entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: Red-haired, grinning leader of the Tuskeri clan, who survives every fight the Valkyrie Njala expects to be his last and earns the name Brokenbrow by breaking a troll's tusk with his head.

entities.name: Njala
entities.description: A Valkyrie of Starnheim who watches mortals to reward the brave, and who grows secretly fond of Arni.

entities.name: Alajn
entities.description: A reaper and Njala's sister, who takes cowards and teases Njala about her failed expectations.

entities.name: Hormgart
entities.description: A gray-mustached dwarven skald feasting in Starnheim, who tells Njala how Arni got his name.

entities.name: Tover Giants-Blood
entities.description: A huge, tattooed Kannah warrior who fights Arni in an honor duel with an iron axe.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A daring and reckless clan of the Tusk mountains led by Arni Brokenbrow.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Raiders in spiked black armor who are routed by the Tuskeri in a skirmish.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A clan of warriors from the Aldergard treeline, including Tover Giants-Blood.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The endless hall where heroes of every clan feast and drink for all time.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of ten realms where this story takes place.

entities.name: Feltmark
entities.description: The green fields where the Tuskeri fight the Skelle raiders.

entities.name: Tusk mountains
entities.description: Mountains of red stone crags where the Tuskeri live and where Arni fights a hellkite and trolls.

entities.name: Red Ridge
entities.description: A ridge in the Tusk mountains whose villages are terrorized by murderous trolls.

entities.name: Aldergard
entities.description: A pine forest where the Kannah warriors gather to face Arni.

events.summary: Njala and Alajn come to watch a skirmish between Skelle raiders and a small Tuskeri war party above the Feltmark.
events.quote: so she and Alajn, shepherd and reaper, had come to watch, and to judge

events.summary: Alajn points out Arni Brokenbrow as the Tuskeri's new leader.
events.quote: That's their new leader. Arni Brokenbrow, they call him.

events.summary: Arni draws his sword and grins as though straight at the unseen Njala.
events.quote: Then he grinned. In fact, he seemed to be grinning right at her.

events.summary: The Tuskeri charge the Skelle line with Arni at the front.
events.quote: the Tuskeri broke into a sudden charge, straight at the middle of the Skelle line

events.summary: Arni leaps over the Skelle spears and shields and kills a raider in the front row.
events.quote: the new leader of the Tuskeri leaped into the air

events.summary: The Tuskeri break the Skelle, who flee, and Arni sits laughing on a pile of the dead while Alajn finds her duties unneeded.
events.quote: Soon the Skelle were broken, fleeing across the open plains.

events.summary: Njala seeks out the skald Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni.
events.quote: She found Hormgart deep into his cups

events.summary: Hormgart begins the tale of how Arni, once called Goatleaper, got his new name (a story told in flashback).
events.quote: He was called Goatleaper, once,

events.summary: In Hormgart's tale, word of murderous trolls on the Red Ridge spreads and Arni's small band begins hunting them (flashback).
events.quote: word spread of a scourge of murderous trolls, terrorizing villages all along the Red Ridge

events.summary: Njala and Alajn watch Arni court death again, this time facing a hellkite in the Tusk mountains.
events.quote: it was a dragon

events.summary: Arni lassoes the hellkite's horn and is flung toward a stone spire, landing on it feet first.
events.quote: he flung the lasso straight into the path of the hellkite's head

events.summary: Arni rides the hellkite and kills it by driving his blade between its horns while his Tuskeri watch.
events.quote: all the Tuskeri gaped, wide-eyed, as their leader drove the blade between the creature's horns

events.summary: In Hormgart's tale, Arni's band finds a whole warren of trolls in a cave and decides not to leave for reinforcements (flashback).
events.quote: Creeping closer, Arni found far more than just a couple stone-eaters.

events.summary: Arni steps out and proposes a headbutting contest to the trolls, the loser to leave the mountains forever (flashback).
events.quote: Loser packs up and leaves these mountains forever.

events.summary: Tover Giants-Blood and the Kannah warriors emerge from the Aldergard treeline to face Arni in an honor duel.
events.quote: Tover Giants-Blood was the biggest human Njala had ever seen.

events.summary: Giants-Blood offers Arni a last chance to grovel and repent for desecrating his family's resting place, and Arni refuses.
events.quote: I'll give you one last chance to repent.

events.summary: Giants-Blood feints and hits Arni in the jaw with the axe haft.
events.quote: Suddenly, Tover brought up the haft of the axe in a sharp jab, cracking into Arni's jaw and sending him flying.

events.summary: Arni steps inside the swing and chops through the axe haft with his sword.
events.quote: chopped down at the wooden haft with his sword

events.summary: Giants-Blood catches Arni in a crushing bear hug and lifts him off the ground.
events.quote: Giants-Blood cinched him tight in a bear hug, pinning his arms to his side and lifting him off the ground

events.summary: Njala realizes she does not want Arni to die and decides she will not allow it.
events.quote: And yet, Njala found that she didn't want Arni to be crushed to death by this bear of a man.

events.summary: Alajn blocks Njala from intervening, since it is an honor duel and Valkyries do not meddle in mortal affairs.
events.quote: Njala, it's an honor duel.

events.summary: Njala sees Arni grinning in the bear hug and remembers how Hormgart's story ended as he draws his head back.
events.quote: Arni drew his head back, back, back

events.summary: In the headbutting contest with the troll, the frightened troll decides to cheat (flashback).
events.quote: he decided to cheat

events.summary: Arni breaks the troll's tusk with his skull, leaving bone embedded in his forehead and losing the name Goatleaper (flashback).
events.quote: the troll lay flat on his back, one of his tusks snapped off at the root

relations.note: Fellow Valkyries who call each other sister.
relations.quote: It seems as though your duties won't need fulfilling today, Sister

relations.note: Arni is the clan's new leader.
relations.quote: He's the new leader of the Tuskeri.

relations.note: Arni and the Tuskeri rout the Skelle raiders.
relations.quote: Soon the Skelle were broken, fleeing across the open plains.

relations.note: Fight an honor duel over the desecration of Tover's family's resting place.
relations.quote: I'll give you one last chance to repent.

relations.note: Tover is one of the Kannah warriors.
relations.quote: He stood a full head and a half over the other Kannah warriors
